scope: Bounty world store and dungeon reward escrow; bounded read, not all permanent progression
findings: BountyBoardData uses server.overworld dataStorage dynasty_bounty and UUID-to-state serialization; BountyService.stateFor uses the same UUID store. This state is not a player ForgeData root field for the proposed Clone whitelist.

Bounty doClaim changes state before inventory delivery; reviewed code does not establish crash-atomic reward persistence. State-machine serialization internals and dispatcher dirty-marking not reviewed in this segment. No broad durability PASS.

DungeonStateStore is dimension-local dynasty_dungeons_v1, keys rooms/encounters by instance and rewards by exact string. Claim uses dungeon first_kill/world and dungeon first_kill/player/UUID, persistent escrow owner and pending copied stacks. Preserve world store ownership rather than transplanting it into player Clone.

reserveReward creates only absent key and marks dirty; delivery checks exact player UUID and marks store dirty on count changes. load retains malformed owner as null, bounds pending list to128. No actual reload, death, invalid-NBT, crash or multiplayer acceptance performed.
Future whitelist must not call doClaim, reserveReward, deliver, or regenerate loot while cloning a player. Existing world data remains separate from lost root player progression.
